session_2025_01_28_async_fix.session_type: Critical Bug Fix - Async/Await Syntax Error

issue_identified.error_type: SyntaxError: await is only valid in async functions and the top level bodies of modules
issue_identified.root_cause: await updatePlayerProgressInDatabase() used inside forEach callback function
issue_identified.impact: Discord bot would not start, preventing command deployment and bot functionality

fix_1.solution: Replaced forEach with for...of loop: for (const playerId of Object.keys(race.playerProgress)) { await updatePlayerProgressInDatabase(...) }
fix_1.rationale: forEach callbacks don't support await, for...of loops properly handle async operations

fix_2.solution: Replaced forEach with for...of loop: for (const player of race.players) { await race.queryDb(...) }
fix_2.rationale: forEach with async callback doesn't wait for promises, for...of ensures proper async handling

fix_3.note: forEach loop checked - no await usage found, safe to leave as-is

fix_4.note: All three forEach loops checked - no await usage found, safe to leave as-is

technical_details.problem_pattern: forEach loops with async callbacks using await
technical_details.solution_pattern: Replace forEach with for...of loops for async operations
